report:
Independently reviewed the complete meta.reviews.review_scope claim, its one ordinary implementation association in review.rs::inventory, and all four ordinary associated tests. There are no TODO/N/A evidence entries for this anchor itself. Requirements assessed: one claim-specific judgment covers implementation completeness and the complete test set; every listed implementation metadata field is retained deterministically; line and byte positions are excluded from association metadata; preview context does not bound semantic review; relevant helper context is captured; reviewers associate essential external implementation code; and source judgment is distinguished from execution.

ReviewImplementation has exactly crate_name, target, module, file, cfg, excerpt, region, status, and explanation, with no positional fields. inventory copies each field from each corresponding implementation site, sorts and deduplicates the resulting collection, and uses a BTreeSet of files to include complete implementation files deterministically. It includes the complete anchor content and all associated test functions in the same ReviewInput. ReviewInput and the prompt therefore permit a single assessment of implementation and tests. The prompt explicitly requires examining all requirements, following helpers, capturing dependencies and separating inspection from execution; the captured review skill explicitly requires adding essential external implementation associations. These are agent workflow obligations, not a claim that code can prove review quality. The relevant review assembly, capture_read, comparison and recording functions are in the already associated review.rs; no additional essential implementation file was needed for this assessment of assembly from correspondence inventory.

initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments checks the full saved input against the returned value, the exact prompt, complete claim, whole implementation file rather than just preview, and complete test function. input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection individually checks crate, target, module, file, inherited cfg, excerpt, point-region flag, ordinary status and absent explanation; it captures extra context and verifies that it appends without changing metadata or preceding fragments. region_association_preserves_placeholder_explanation_and_excerpt checks a region association with Todo status, nested module identity, explanation prerequisite and excerpt contents, and verifies saved metadata equals the returned metadata. accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence covers both placeholder classifications, retained explanations, successful recording and checking while approval remains zero and the appropriate TODO/N/A count remains visible. Together these assertions detect omission or misrepresentation of metadata, loss of whole-file context and relabeling deferred evidence. Deterministic order and absence of position fields are also directly evident in the typed representation and sorting code; additional field-by-field tests are not needed for this evidence set.

Captured the fixture setup and helpers at tests/review.rs lines 1-100, the review specification, and the review skill using review read. Fixture start/input/report helpers perform setup or direct persistence operations; meaningful assertions remain in the four supplied test bodies. This review did not rely on historical test names or previous snapshot formats: the current implementation uses uniform fragments and has been assessed as such. Source inspection found no gap requiring a regression or requested edit.

Commands actually executed were cargo meta review start and cargo meta review read, plus source/report inspection and report creation; this report is submitted with cargo meta review record. I did not execute tests or a workspace build. The coordinator separately reported passing functional sage-meta tests and root cargo build; those results are execution evidence from the coordinator, not commands run by this reviewer.
